sample_unit: ChatGPT responses (16 FAQs plus 2 psychosocial questions, each queried multiple times)

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT clinical answers on congenital hand differences, graded by surgeons
links.effect: Of 164 grades, 83 (51%) needed no clarification, 37 (23%) minimal, 32 (20%) moderate, 13 (8%) unsatisfactory; considerable variability in depth; omitted that syndromic involvement is rare.
links.quote: In total, 164 grades were assigned to the 82 ChatGPT responses: 83 (51%) did not require any clarification, 37 (23%) required minimal clarification, 32 (20%) required moderate clarification, and 13 (8%) received an unsatisfactory rating.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT-4.0's accuracy and reliability in answering patient FAQs regarding congenital upper limb differences without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
